subject: math
question:
设函数 $f(x)$ 在 x=0 的某邻域内有二阶连续导数，且 $f(0), f'(0), f''(0)$ 均不为零。证明存在唯一一组实数 $k_{1}, k_{2}, k_{3}$ ，使得

\lim _ {h \rightarrow 0} \frac {k _ {1} f (h) + k _ {2} f (2 h) + k _ {3} f (3 h) - f (0)}{h ^ {2}} = 0.

steps.text: 分析 这属于 $\frac{0}{0}$ 型，分母为 $h^2$ ，可用两次洛必达法则，由分子极限为零可得 $k_{1}, k_{2}, k_{3}$ 的线性方程组，解方程组可求得 $k_{1}, k_{2}, k_{3}$ 的值.
\lim _ {h \rightarrow 0} \left(k _ {1} f (h) + k _ {2} f (2 h) + k _ {3} f (3 h) - f (0)\right) = \left(k _ {1} + k _ {2} + k _ {3} - 1\right) f (0) = 0,

\begin{array}{r l} 0 & = \lim _ {h \to 0} \frac {k _ {1} f (h) + k _ {2} f (2 h) + k _ {3} f (3 h) - f (0)}{h ^ {2}} \\ & = \lim _ {h \to 0} \frac {k _ {1} f ^ {\prime} (h) + 2 k _ {2} f ^ {\prime} (2 h) + 3 k _ {3} f ^ {\prime} (3 h)}{2 h}. \end{array}\tag{②}
